attBesluta.text: Heavy door, looks expensive, but not for a sliding barn door, especially with the hardware included!

I’m happy with this sliding barn door overall. The door looks great once installed, feels solid, and the final result is really nice. It definitely adds style and character to the space. However, the installation was not easy at all. Some of the instructions were hard to understand, and the installation video didn’t fully match or follow the steps shown in the manual, which made the process more confusing than it needed to be. That said, once everything was finally installed, I really loved the result. Good product and good value for money, but clearer instructions and better-aligned video guidance would make the experience much better.
